ModMetaData.name: Medieval Overhaul - Recycle Only 1.5 v1.7
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Adds recycling only to Medieval Overhaul's existing mending bench. Recycle bills accept damaged or full-durability items. Every recycle job takes exactly 5000 game ticks (2 in-game hours), independent of durability, material, MaxHP or work speed. Completion dismantles the item into materials instead of repairing it.
